# FloatSlider { #anylumino.FloatSlider }

```python
FloatSlider(
    value=0.0,
    min=0.0,
    max=100.0,
    step=0.1,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    orientation='horizontal',
    readout=True,
    readout_format='.2f',
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

Float slider control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `0.0` |
| min | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value. | `0.0` |
| max | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value. | `100.0` |
| step | optional | Increment size. | `0.1` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |
| orientation | optional | ``'horizontal'`` or ``'vertical'``. | `'horizontal'` |
| readout | optional | Slider readout visibility or validity readout text. | `True` |
| readout_format | optional | Format string used for slider readouts. | `'.2f'` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [behavior](#anylumino.FloatSlider.behavior) | Slider dragging behavior. |
| [continuous_update](#anylumino.FloatSlider.continuous_update) | Update the value of the widget as the user is holding the slider. |
| [disabled](#anylumino.FloatSlider.disabled) | Enable or disable user changes |
| [orientation](#anylumino.FloatSlider.orientation) | Vertical or horizontal. |
| [readout](#anylumino.FloatSlider.readout) | Display the current value of the slider next to it. |
| [readout_format](#anylumino.FloatSlider.readout_format) | Format for the readout |
| [step](#anylumino.FloatSlider.step) | Minimum step to increment the value |
| [style](#anylumino.FloatSlider.style) | An instance trait which coerces a dict to an instance. |
